greet.speaker: The Reliquary Warden
greet.text: A towering shape unfolds from an alcove of half-shattered wards, ancient runes flaring back to life along its frame. Its voice is a grinding echo of something long dead. "You are not on the roster of those permitted here."
greet.text_zh: 一道巨大的身影從半毀的結界壁龕中展開，古老的符文沿著它的軀體重新亮起。它的聲音如研磨般迴響，彷彿來自某個早已死去許久的存在：「你不在允許進入此處的名冊之上。」

choices.text: Then add me the hard way.
choices.text_zh: 那就讓我用強硬的方式加入名冊。

battle_start.speaker: The Reliquary Warden
battle_start.text: "As you wish. The wards remember every trespasser eventually — one way or another."
battle_start.text_zh: 「隨你的意。結界終究會記住每一位闖入者——用某種方式。」

already_won.text: The runes along the alcove have gone dark. Whatever watched this floor is watching no longer — but somewhere far below, something else still is.
already_won.text_zh: 壁龕上的符文已經黯淡下去。曾經守望著這一層的存在，如今已不再守望——但在更深、更遠的地方，仍有其他東西在守望著。
